name: boodoo
description: boodoo — a modular, mobile-first, responsive CSS design framework inspired by Bootstrap, Foundation, Tailwind CSS and Material Design. Ships as a Sass/LESS source, compiled CSS, vanilla JS, and an npm package with a CDN-ready build.

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:unit && npm run site
scripts.build: npm run css && npm run js
scripts.css: npm run css:main && npm run css:grid && npm run css:reboot && npm run css:utilities && npm run css:anim && npm run css:less
scripts.css:main: sass --quiet-deps --silence-deprecation=global-builtin,color-functions,slash-div,import,if-function scss/boodoo.scss dist/css/boodoo.css && sass --quiet-deps --silence-deprecation=global-builtin,color-functions,slash-div,import,if-function scss/boodoo.scss dist/css/boodoo.min.css --style=compressed
scripts.css:grid: sass --quiet-deps --silence-deprecation=global-builtin,color-functions,slash-div,import,if-function scss/boodoo-grid.scss dist/css/boodoo-grid.css && sass --quiet-deps --silence-deprecation=global-builtin,color-functions,slash-div,import,if-function scss/boodoo-grid.scss dist/css/boodoo-grid.min.css --style=compressed
scripts.css:reboot: sass --quiet-deps --silence-deprecation=global-builtin,color-functions,slash-div,import,if-function scss/boodoo-reboot.scss dist/css/boodoo-reboot.css && sass --quiet-deps --silence-deprecation=global-builtin,color-functions,slash-div,import,if-function scss/boodoo-reboot.scss dist/css/boodoo-reboot.min.css --style=compressed
scripts.css:utilities: sass --quiet-deps --silence-deprecation=global-builtin,color-functions,slash-div,import,if-function scss/boodoo-utilities.scss dist/css/boodoo-utilities.css && sass --quiet-deps --silence-deprecation=global-builtin,color-functions,slash-div,import,if-function scss/boodoo-utilities.scss dist/css/boodoo-utilities.min.css --style=compressed
scripts.css:anim: sass --quiet-deps --silence-deprecation=global-builtin,color-functions,slash-div,import,if-function scss/boodoo-animations.scss dist/css/boodoo-animations.css && sass --quiet-deps --silence-deprecation=global-builtin,color-functions,slash-div,import,if-function scss/boodoo-animations.scss dist/css/boodoo-animations.min.css --style=compressed
